RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Guard Stance
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Open a 2-second guard window. Blocking one direct attack readies Riposte. Fixed 12-second recovery. Manual only. These are base-form values; inspect the build panel and health status for the selected branch.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Riposte
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Spend a stored riposte to deal 10 base ability damage to an enemy within 2 cells. The opportunity lasts 4 seconds. Manual only. These are base-form values; inspect the build panel and health status for the selected branch.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Deploy Mine
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Deploy a temporary mine that arms after 1 second and lasts 30 seconds. Limit 3 per owner, 12 per map. Fixed 6-second deployment interval. Manual only. These are base-form values; inspect the build panel and health status for the selected branch.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Detonate Mine
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Choose one of your armed mines to detonate immediately for area secondary damage. Manual only. These are base-form values; inspect the build panel and health status for the selected branch.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Disarm Mine
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Remove one of your untriggered mines. Returns no resources and does not reset deployment recovery. Warning mines cannot be disarmed. Manual only. These are base-form values; inspect the build panel and health status for the selected branch.
